multiplatform-ci|Linux macOS Windows CI|jpeglib_complete passes on all supported CI operating systems|strict CI matrix with platform dependency setup|closed|GitHub Actions ci run 32572734862 passed ubuntu-latest macos-15-intel windows-latest
expanded-real-world-corpus|camera phone web editor print malformed-common JPEG corpus|broad pinned manifest with header metadata decode and policy expectations|strict corpus manifest plus digest/output checks|closed|jpeglib_real_world passed 19-row typed corpus with 17 valid decodes and 2 malformed rejections
lossless-transform-api|jpegtran-style coefficient-domain transforms|rotate flip transpose crop optimize and valid baseline/progressive conversion|public API CLI AUnit and external jpegtran comparison where available|closed|Jpeglib.Coefficients.Transform_Image plus foundation.coefficients.public_image_transforms and jpeglib_transform --self-test cover block-grid rotate flip transpose transverse and crop; Jpeglib.Coefficients.Encoding emits baseline and progressive grayscale and YCbCr coefficient JPEGs with AC round-trip coverage; Optimize_Huffman emits coefficient-derived DHT tables covered by foundation.coefficients.public_encode_grayscale_baseline and foundation.coefficients.public_encode_ycbcr_baseline; jpeglib_transform --self-test compares native transpose coefficients against jpegtran when jpegtran is available
encoder-optimization|competitive encoder optimization layer|optimized Huffman progressive scan optimization perceptual presets and target-size search|deterministic compression quality benchmark matrix|closed|Jpeglib.Encoding exposes Optimize_Huffman Target_Bytes and perceptual presets; image encoders derive optimized DHT tables from generated DCT blocks for sequential and progressive Huffman JPEGs; jpeglib_encoder_optimization enforces deterministic default optimized progressive preset and target-size byte relationships
precision-buffer-api|broader public precision and buffer support|high-bit-depth public views and legal lossless precision expansion|public API tests for preserve clamp scale reject policies|closed|Jpeglib.Decoding exposes Raw_Output_Precision and Raw_Precision policies for raw component output; Decode_Raw_Components validates one-byte and two-byte caller buffers and implements scale clamp preserve and reject behavior for legal 12-bit lossless streams; jpeglib_precision_buffer enforces the public policy matrix
performance-architecture|scalar/SIMD performance architecture|hot-path profiling scalar reference benchmarks and hostkit-backed platform acceleration hooks|benchmark thresholds plus scalar equivalence tests|closed|Jpeglib.Internal.Colors exposes compiler-vectorized RGB-to-YCbCr gray-alpha and CMYK/YCCK row input kernels used by encoder plane filling plus YCbCr-to-RGB-family direct RGB gray gray-alpha CMYK and YCCK row output kernels used by encoder chroma downsampling for 4:4:4 4:2:2 4:2:0 and 4:1:1 plus direct full-size grayscale two-component three-component four-component lossless 4:4:4 DCT and direct-output three-component subsampled DCT decode row output; Jpeglib.Capabilities advertises SIMD_Acceleration; jpeglib_simd_matrix uses hostkit and checks bit-exact scalar equivalence across every public input output and downsampling layout; jpeglib_performance_matrix reports the active acceleration profile and runs baseline progressive and arithmetic encode/decode thresholds
